clue.text: Service finally made to employ female therapist

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word it follows

blocks.note: Mass is a church service
the final letter of this word
to employ something is to use it

explanation.surface: A therapist hired at the end of a church service, as if the parish laid on a massage.
explanation.definitionFit: A masseuse is a woman who gives massages professionally, a kind of physical therapist.

clue.text: Old man gets old wall moulding

blocks.note: one's old man is one's father
O is the standard abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: An elderly man acquires some antique decorative woodwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old man' is slang for father, so the first old is not an abbreviation but part of a phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A dado is the lower band of an interior wall, often finished with a decorative rail or moulding.

clue.text: Company messenger heading off as escort

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter, and taking it off removes that letter

blocks.note: Co is the abbreviation for company
an envoy carries messages between governments

explanation.surface: A firm's courier sets off to act as a bodyguard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heading off' reads as setting out on a journey, but it tells you to drop the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A convoy is a group of ships or vehicles travelling together under protection, an escort being a protective accompaniment.

clue.text: Editor rising to partner's challenge

indicators.note: in a down clue, a word that rises is read from bottom to top

blocks.note: Ed is the usual abbreviation for editor
a fiancé is a partner one is engaged to

explanation.surface: An editor stands up to meet a challenge set by a partner.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Defiance is open resistance or a challenge to authority, as in acting in defiance of orders.

clue.text: Dean alarms swimming amphibian

indicators.note: letters that are swimming are moving about freely, so they settle into a new order

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A college dean is startled by a creature paddling in the water.
explanation.definitionFit: The salamander is a lizard-shaped amphibian related to newts, living partly in water.

clue.text: Prize bull losing footing in space

indicators.note: the foot of a down entry is its bottom letter, and losing it drops the last letter
one piece sits within the other, which wraps around it

blocks.note: an em is a printer's unit of space
a steer is a young castrated bull

explanation.surface: A prize-winning bull stumbles and loses its footing in an open space.
explanation.walkthrough: STEER minus its last letter is STEE, placed in EM. An em is the width of a letter M in printing.
explanation.definitionFit: To prize something is to hold it in high regard, which is what esteeming it means.

clue.text: Animal and a collection of teeth found in burial site

blocks.note: a cat is an animal
taken as written
a comb is a row of teeth

explanation.surface: Archaeologists find an animal and a set of teeth in a tomb.
explanation.walkthrough: A comb's prongs are called teeth, so 'collection of teeth' is not a jaw.
explanation.definitionFit: Catacombs are underground cemeteries with recesses for tombs, as in ancient Rome.

clue.text: Mild chap ordered gin

indicators.note: something ordered has been arranged, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: Ben is a man's name, a typical chap
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gentle fellow asks the barman for a gin.
explanation.definitionFit: Benign means gentle or harmless, as in a benign climate or a benign tumour.

clue.text: Pass starter of extra large mushy peas

indicators.note: the starter of a word is its opening letter
mushy things have been mashed out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: first letter of the word
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone passes on a starter of an extra large helping of mushy peas.
explanation.walkthrough: Mushy peas are a British side dish of mashed marrowfat peas, often served with fish and chips.
explanation.definitionFit: When time passes it elapses, as in months had elapsed since the meeting.

clue.text: Ghettos loosely surrounding northern capital

indicators.note: the clue's own words surround the answer, which sits within their letters

blocks.note: spans the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: Run-down districts spread loosely around a Scandinavian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital of Norway, a country in the far north of Europe.

clue.text: Five shown to be justified

blocks.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
shown or pointed out

explanation.surface: Five people are proved right after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone vindicated has been cleared or proved right, their actions justified by events.

clue.text: Australian leaving country in need of food

indicators.note: someone leaving goes away, so that letter departs from the word

blocks.note: A is the abbreviation for Australian
a central European country

explanation.surface: An Australian emigrant departs from a country short of food.
explanation.walkthrough: HUNGARY without its A gives HUNGRY.
explanation.definitionFit: Being hungry means feeling the want of something to eat, an empty stomach.

clue.text: Environmentalists planting new vegetable in Mediterranean country

indicators.note: planting something in a place sets it down inside it

blocks.note: a country on the Mediterranean
N is the abbreviation for new
the pea is a vegetable

explanation.surface: Green campaigners plant a new crop in Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: The new letter and the vegetable go in together, just before the country's C.
explanation.definitionFit: Greenpeace is an international campaigning organisation dedicated to protecting the natural world.

clue.text: Officer's endgame designed to trap king

indicators.note: designed means arranged to a plan, so these letters are set out afresh
trapping something closes it inside the rest

blocks.note: taken as written
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A chess player's endgame is planned to trap the opposing king.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is'. 'Endgame' and 'king' sound like chess but the king here is just R.
explanation.definitionFit: A gendarme is a French police officer, from a paramilitary force.

clue.text: First lady books special occasions

blocks.note: Eve was the first woman in Genesis
NT is the New Testament, a set of books
S is the abbreviation for special

explanation.surface: A president's wife books venues for some special functions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First lady' suggests a president's wife, but here it is the biblical Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: Events are things that happen, especially notable occasions such as ceremonies or parties.

clue.text: Measures concentration shown by bird judges

blocks.note: the tit is a small songbird
to rate is to judge or assess

explanation.surface: A bird's powers of concentration are assessed by judges.
explanation.definitionFit: Titration is the laboratory method of finding a solution's strength by adding a reagent until a reaction is complete.

clue.text: Go from door to door selling bicycle part, reportedly

definitions.text: Go from door to door selling

indicators.note: what is reported is heard spoken, so the sound matters rather than the spelling

blocks.note: the lever a cyclist pushes with the foot

explanation.surface: A travelling salesman goes round houses selling bike parts.
explanation.definitionFit: To peddle is to hawk goods by travelling about, like a pedlar calling on homes.

clue.text: Always remove injured soldiers

indicators.note: something injured is damaged out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

explanation.surface: An order to always take away wounded troops from the field.
explanation.definitionFit: Evermore is a literary word for for ever, at all times to come.

clue.text: Learnt about feature of some animals

indicators.note: about suggests being turned round and round, so the letters are scattered into new order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A student has studied some characteristic of the animal kingdom.
explanation.definitionFit: An antler is the branched bony growth on the head of deer, moose and similar animals.

clue.text: Waterborne creatures arrange untied knot

indicators.note: an untied knot comes loose, so its letters are freed to form a new order

blocks.note: to plan is to arrange
taken as written

explanation.surface: Tiny sea creatures are told to sort out a loosened knot.
explanation.definitionFit: Plankton are the minute organisms that drift in seas and lakes, carried along by water.

clue.text: The French claimed independence with the German songs

indicators.note: something claimed is taken in and held, so one letter goes inside the other piece

blocks.note: le is French for the
I is the abbreviation for independence or independent
der is German for the

explanation.surface: The French declared independence while the Germans sang.
explanation.definitionFit: Lieder are German art songs, especially Romantic settings of poems for voice and piano by Schubert or Schumann.

clue.text: Father to include service before end of aisle is repaired

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter
to include is to take in, so the father wraps round the rest

blocks.note: an informal word for father
the Royal Navy, one of the armed services
the final letter of this word

explanation.surface: A church aisle, with a priest leading a service, is being mended.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Service' and 'aisle' suggest a church, but the service here is the navy.
explanation.definitionFit: Darned means mended by weaving thread across a hole, as with socks.

clue.text: Stop in dodgy side street

indicators.note: dodgy means unreliable or out of order, so these letters are muddled

blocks.note: taken as written
St is the usual abbreviation for street

explanation.surface: Someone is told to halt in a shady back street.
explanation.definitionFit: To desist is to cease or leave off doing something, formal for stop.

clue.text: Eve out to secure good places to eat garden produce

indicators.note: out suggests disorder, so these letters are shuffled out of place
to secure something is to hold it fast inside

blocks.note: taken as written
G is the abbreviation for good
tables are where meals are eaten

explanation.surface: Eve goes out to book good restaurants serving home-grown vegetables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eve out' reads as Eve going out for dinner, but out only rearranges her three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Vegetables are the edible plants grown in a kitchen garden, such as carrots or beans.

clue.text: Adam finally taken in by falsehood gets fruit

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word before it
being taken in by something places it inside that thing

blocks.note: a lie is a falsehood
the final letter of the name

explanation.surface: Adam, at last fooled by a lie, receives some fruit, a twist on the Eden story.
explanation.definitionFit: The lime is a small green citrus fruit with sour juice.

clue.text: Light using large unit of electrical current

blocks.note: L is the abbreviation for large
the ampere, the SI unit of current

explanation.surface: A light bulb drawing a big electrical load.
explanation.definitionFit: Light here is a noun naming a source of illumination, and a lamp is one such source.

clue.text: Doctor cures earl for free

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so these letters are altered in order

blocks.note: taken as written
E is the abbreviation for earl

explanation.surface: A doctor treats an aristocrat without charging.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For free' reads as no charge, but 'for' is a link and free is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To rescue someone is to set them loose from danger or captivity, to liberate them.

clue.text: Frisky mare tucked into healthy-looking plant

indicators.note: a frisky animal jumps about playfully, so these letters move around
something tucked into another is pushed inside it

blocks.note: taken as written
rosy cheeks suggest good health

explanation.surface: A lively horse tucks into some lush greenery.
explanation.definitionFit: Rosemary is an aromatic evergreen shrub whose needle-like leaves are used as a herb.
